definitions.explanation: The act of joining or becoming a member of a group, organization, plan, or service. Commonly used for formal memberships such as insurance, unions, international organizations, and subscription services.

examples.japanese: {保険|ほけん}に{加入|かにゅう}した。
{組合|くみあい}への{加入|かにゅう}を{検討|けんとう}している。
この{国|くに}は{来年|らいねん}、{国際機関|こくさいきかん}に{正式|せいしき}に{加入|かにゅう}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: This country is scheduled to formally join the international organization next year.

notes:
Used for formal, institutional membership — not for casually joining a group of friends. The particle に marks what is being joined, and the particle に or への introduces the target.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜に{加入|かにゅう}する (to join ~)
・〜への{加入|かにゅう} (joining ~)
・{加入|かにゅう}{者|しゃ} (member, subscriber)
・{加入|かにゅう}{手続|てつづ}き (enrollment procedure)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{加入|かにゅう} — joining a group/plan/service (formal membership)
・{入会|にゅうかい} — joining a club or association
・{参加|さんか} — participating in an event or activity
